notes: Monday and Tuesday: 34 venue nights in the guide, 12 confirmed from the venue's own pages or the host's schedule. Monday confirmed: Plough & The Stars, Marsha's, Cavanaugh's, Victory. Tuesday confirmed: Jerry's Bar, Founding Fathers, J.D. McGillicuddy's, Bar-Ly, Top Tomato, Fergie's, Bourbon & Branch, Mount Airy Tap Room. Host schedule used: johnnygoodtimes.com. Its undated weekly list shows Tuesday Founding Fathers at 8 pm and Tuesday Samuel Gritz at 8 pm, and no Monday nights, which conflicts with the guide's Jose Pistola's Monday entry. Samuel Gritz is NOT recorded as an entry: no venue website was found (a guessed address did not resolve), and a 2024 news article places Samuel Gritz Public House at 629 South 2nd St, but that is not a venue page and does not mention trivia. It needs the venue's own site or a direct check before it can be added. Not checked: Santucci's (no website linked). Billy Murphy's and The Pub on Passyunk East have no reachable website (guessed addresses did not resolve). The Pub on Passyunk East (monthly per the guide) and Dawson Street Pub (every other Tuesday per the guide) are not weekly and are flagged in their notes. Fergie's Thursday quiz and the Thursday items on the host list are outside this slice. Budget: 3 of 3 WebSearch used; about 52 of 60 WebFetch used.
